title: Audition simultaneous sequence tracks
changes: Allow a song’s extracted tracks to be auditioned together or individually, with track-attributed note and instruction timelines.
Bound combined work and scale synthetic voices using the maximum number of simultaneously active notes.
validation: Synthetic Linux Chrome units rom-data-viewer-multitrack-q62ctukb and rom-data-viewer-multitrack-mix-e4bpfoob checked individual selection, concurrent scheduling, overlap gain bound, stop behavior, ties and trace limits.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-multitrack-eur-919lx0o8 exercised a twelve-track song, individual selection, Web Audio start/stop and an empty song.
limitations: This remains a bounded sine-wave approximation with a user-selected tick rate; original instruments, tempo, pitch commands, effects and driver fidelity are not reproduced. Physical audio output was not checked.
